title: Disclaimer of interest by trustee.
bodyText: If a trustee disclaims an interest in property that otherwise would have become trust property, the interest does not become trust property.
bodyHtml: [§526-8]  Disclaimer of interest by trustee.  If a trustee disclaims an interest in property that otherwise would have become trust property, the interest does not become trust property. [L 2000, c 43, pt of §1]
